title: A Dictionary of the English Language
author: Samuel Johnson
edition: First edition, London 1755, in two volumes (no edition statement on the title page)
words_note: 3,475,640 is the cleaned-text total (parent-verified). Entry text totals 3,457,343 words; the gap is the file header, page markers and the text of entries the parser missed (still present in the cleaned file in reading order).
letters_note: Johnson has real J (272 entries) and U (1,419 entries) sections, so j.json and u.json exist. Entries are filed by the first letter of the lookup key; the site looks an entry up by fetching the file named after the first letter of its key.
corrections_note: 389,325 by the cleanup engine (long-s 307,749; edit 28,739; edit2 15,369; split 15,724; split+long-s 5,494; split+edit 1,426; case 1,855; pos 1,279; manual 11,690) + 18,902 by the sentence context pass (50 rules).
citation: Johnson's Dictionary is paginated. Cite entries by volume and printed page (e.g. OATS, vol. 2, p. 223).
entry_count_note: 32,890 parsed entries is below the commonly cited ~42,773. A per-page calibration (vol. 1, p. 100, read as an image) found 14 of 21 entries there. The missing kinds: headwords entirely lowercase in the OCR, headword lines too garbled for the parser, multi-word Latin headwords. No entry was invented; missed entries' text is still present in the cleaned file in reading order.
front_matter_note: No frontmatter.json: Johnson's preface, History of the Language and English Grammar are not in the cleanup deliverables; the cleaned text begins at printed page 1.
source: BIM scans bim_eighteenth-century_a-dictionary-of-the-engl_johnson-samuel-lld_1755_1 and _1755_2 (Wellcome scan cross-checked against the BIM scan). Title pages verified from the printed images (leaf 8 of each scan).
